nodes.title: Positive Prompt
widgets_values:
The massive, battle-worn mech descends violently through the upper atmosphere, punching through layers of cloud as powerful white-blue energy erupts downward from its damaged chassis. The camera holds wide as the machine drifts farther downard into the cloudy sky.

As it sinks, violent white-blue burst from within the mech's damaged structure, magnetically pulls in levitating components, repairing the outer shell in the process. The descent gradually increases in intensity.
